_comment: TEMPLATE -- not loaded by Claude Code.
This file lives under mcp/ rather than at the plugin root, and the plugin
manifest declares no `mcpServers` key. Both are deliberate: Claude Code
starts a plugin's MCP servers the moment the plugin is enabled, which would
produce a failed server entry before the user has been told that
/theurian:setup exists -- and FR-L3 requires that installing the plugin have
/theurian:setup installs this entry at user scope. See ADR-0012.
The Authorization header carries an environment-variable reference, never a
literal token: config files get copied into gists, synced to dotfile repos,
and pasted into issues. THEURIAN_MCP_TOKEN is exported from ~/.theurian/env
(mode 0600), which reads the token from ~/.theurian/auth/mcp-token. See ADR-0011.
